title: Selling Plans Refund Credits — Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) Relief
content:
A refunded order that shipped from the Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) network earns a fixed relief on the administration fee withheld from its **Selling Plans** refund credit. The relief reads the outbound shipment recorded for the order in the seller's FBN activity.

**Rule.** The FBN refund relief is the same-day FBN refund relief when the refunded order's FBN outbound shipment is dated the same calendar day as its variable fee record, the FBN refund relief when that shipment is dated later, and nothing when the order has no FBN outbound shipment. The FBN refund relief is subtracted after the cap and never takes the fee below zero.

| FBN outbound shipment of the refunded order | Relief subtracted from the refund administration fee |
|---|---|
| Same calendar day as the variable fee record | USD 3.00 (same-day FBN refund relief) |
| A later day | USD 1.50 (FBN refund relief) |
| None recorded | Nothing |

## Worked sequence (hypothetical)

| Fee after the cap | Shipment | Fee withheld |
|---|---|---|
| USD 7.50 | Same day | USD 4.50 |
| USD 2.34 | Next day | USD 0.84 |
| USD 2.34 | Same day | USD 0.00 — never below zero |
| USD 2.34 | Seller-shipped, no FBN outbound shipment | USD 2.34 |
